Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement & hosting preference — Stella Health

Hi Kayla —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get procurement moving smoothly: 

Recap from call:
- Goal: Proof-of-concept in staging, then production migration for clinical search use-case (expected Q3).
- Performance target: <100ms per request P95 for interactive queries.
- Data posture: sensitive PHI-mapped metadata; customer prefers VPC/private deployment but open to Dedicated if required.

Questions for procurement readiness (short answers appreciated):
1) Purchase route: Do you prefer PO (Finance) or payment card/charge (on-demand)?
2) Marketplace: Would buying via AWS Marketplace simplify procurement for you, or do you need a direct Redwood PO?
3) Hosting preference: Hosted API vs Dedicated GPU pool vs Private (on-prem/VPC)? If you said "Dedicated or Private", are you able to commit to a 6/12 month reserved plan or do you need on-demand?
4) Billing terms: Net-30/Net-45? Any required language for invoices (BU name, tax ID)?
5) Procurement contact + PO template: please share contact and any templates we should use.

Attachments: Redwood_Procurement_OnePager.pdf (procurement-friendly summary), sample quote stub (RWI-Quote-STELLA-2027.xlsx).

Proposed next steps from our side:
- I’ll pull a PO-ready quote and a procurement one-pager tailored to Dedicated vs Hosted options and include commit vs on-demand pricing.
- Loop in Lauren (contracts) if you need MSA tweaks.
- If you prefer Marketplace, we’ll confirm SKU mapping and marketplace invoicing.

Can you confirm the answers above and the procurement contact? If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min procurement sync with Alicia/Finance this week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. Short answers below to help you build the PO-ready materials: 

1) Purchase route: Procurement requires PO for contracts over $25k. We cannot use a corporate card for committed spends.
2) Marketplace: We're evaluating AWS Marketplace but Finance prefers a direct PO for discounts and SOW attachments. Marketplace is a fallback if timing requires it.
3) Hosting preference: We prefer Dedicated GPU pools (data residency + control) but may consider a Private VPC if minimum on-prem footprint is needed.
   - Commit appetite: likely 12-month commitment for baseline capacity, with burst/on-demand top-up.
4) Billing terms: Net-30 is standard for us. Invoices should be addressed to: Stella Health, Inc. Attn: AP, 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105; Tax ID: 94-1234567.
5) Procurement contact: Alicia Chen (cc'd) handles POs and vendor onboarding. Our PO template attached. 

Also need: SOC 2 + encryption/KMS notes and clarifications on data egress and retention to include in our security review. Can you include the SOC2 summary and a short note on KMS/HSM support?

Timeline: If we can get a PO-ready quote and MSA redlines by end of week, procurement can turn around PO in ~2 weeks.

Thanks,
Kayla Morgan
Head of Applied AI
Stella Health

- SOC2 summary + KMS note (SOC2_Summary.pdf) and a short FAQ on data retention/egress.
- MSA + simple SOW template for the pilot (we'll highlight any T&C items that routinely surface).

Action items for Alicia / Stella Finance to accelerate PO: please confirm the billing address above and upload your PO template (attached is the copy we received). Also let us know if DocuSign for the MSA is acceptable.

Lauren — can you review standard net-30 wording and confirm there's no blocker for the proposed 12-month commit? Monica — can you prepare a recommended Dedicated baseline (GPU type, vCPU/memory, expected token throughput) for the pricing sheet.

I'll send the initial packet as a single ZIP with the quote, one-pager, SOC2 summary, and MSA redlines.
